name: Vasboldogasszony (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light grey at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vasboldogasszony: a blue and yellow shield with a ploughshare and the Virgin and Child.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
